<?php
/**
 * Distributed Cache Client with Reverse Proxy Support
 * Handles memcached protocol communication through HTTP proxy layer
 */

class CacheKeyEncoder
{
    private $namespace;
    private $proxyHeaders;

    public function __construct(string $namespace, array $proxyHeaders = [])
    {
        $this->namespace = $namespace;
        $this->proxyHeaders = $proxyHeaders;
    }

    /**
     * Encode cache key for safe transmission through proxy layer.
     * The proxy uses LATIN-1 for header values per HTTP/1.0 spec compliance.
     * We normalize to ASCII-safe representation.
     */
    public function encodeKey(string $userKey): string
    {
        // Strip control characters that could break memcached protocol
        $sanitized = preg_replace('/[\x00-\x1f\x7f]/', '', $userKey);
        
        // Encode non-ASCII bytes for proxy compatibility
        $encoded = $this->proxyEncode($sanitized);
        
        // Namespace isolation
        return $this->namespace . ':' . $encoded;
    }

    /**
     * Proxy-safe encoding: handles the LATIN-1 boundary at the reverse proxy.
     * The proxy normalizes headers using iconv LATIN-1 -> UTF-8 on responses.
     * We pre-encode to survive the round-trip.
     */
    private function proxyEncode(string $input): string
    {
        $result = '';
        $len = strlen($input);
        for ($i = 0; $i < $len; $i++) {
            $byte = ord($input[$i]);
            if ($byte >= 0x20 && $byte <= 0x7E && $byte !== 0x25) {
                // Printable ASCII (except %) passes through unchanged
                $result .= $input[$i];
            } else {
                // Percent-encode non-ASCII and special bytes
                $result .= '%' . sprintf('%02X', $byte);
            }
        }
        return $result;
    }
}

class DistributedCacheClient
{
    private $encoder;
    private $servers;
    private $hashRing;

    public function __construct(CacheKeyEncoder $encoder, array $servers)
    {
        $this->encoder = $encoder;
        $this->servers = $servers;
        $this->hashRing = $this->buildHashRing($servers);
    }

    private function buildHashRing(array $servers): array
    {
        $ring = [];
        foreach ($servers as $server) {
            for ($i = 0; $i < 150; $i++) {
                $hash = crc32($server . '#' . $i);
                $ring[$hash] = $server;
            }
        }
        ksort($ring);
        return $ring;
    }

    private function getServer(string $key): string
    {
        $hash = crc32($key);
        foreach ($this->hashRing as $nodeHash => $server) {
            if ($hash <= $nodeHash) {
                return $server;
            }
        }
        return reset($this->hashRing);
    }

    /**
     * Store value in distributed cache.
     * Key is encoded for proxy-safe transmission.
     */
    public function set(string $userKey, $value, int $ttl = 3600): bool
    {
        $encodedKey = $this->encoder->encodeKey($userKey);
        $server = $this->getServer($encodedKey);
        
        return $this->sendCommand($server, 'set', $encodedKey, $value, $ttl);
    }

    /**
     * Retrieve value from distributed cache.
     */
    public function get(string $userKey)
    {
        $encodedKey = $this->encoder->encodeKey($userKey);
        $server = $this->getServer($encodedKey);
        
        return $this->sendCommand($server, 'get', $encodedKey, null, 0);
    }

    /**
     * Delete a cache entry. Supports wildcard prefix deletion
     * when the key ends with '*'.
     */
    public function delete(string $userKey): bool
    {
        $encodedKey = $this->encoder->encodeKey($userKey);
        $server = $this->getServer($encodedKey);
        
        return $this->sendCommand($server, 'delete', $encodedKey, null, 0);
    }

    /**
     * Build and send memcached text protocol command through proxy.
     * Protocol: <command> <key> <flags> <exptime> <bytes>\r\n<data>\r\n
     */
    private function sendCommand(string $server, string $cmd, string $key, $value, int $ttl): bool
    {
        // Validate key length per memcached protocol (250 byte limit)
        if (strlen($key) > 250) {
            $key = substr($key, 0, 200) . '_' . md5($key);
        }

        // Build the protocol line - key is already encoded by CacheKeyEncoder
        $serialized = ($value !== null) ? serialize($value) : '';
        
        switch ($cmd) {
            case 'set':
                $protocol = "set {$key} 0 {$ttl} " . strlen($serialized) . "\r\n{$serialized}\r\n";
                break;
            case 'get':
                $protocol = "get {$key}\r\n";
                break;
            case 'delete':
                $protocol = "delete {$key}\r\n";
                break;
            default:
                return false;
        }

        return $this->transmitViaProxy($server, $protocol);
    }

    /**
     * Transmit command through the reverse proxy layer.
     * The proxy decodes percent-encoded sequences in the X-Cache-Command header
     * before forwarding to the backend memcached instance.
     */
    private function transmitViaProxy(string $server, string $protocol): bool
    {
        $proxyUrl = 'http://' . $server . ':11211/cache';
        
        $ch = curl_init($proxyUrl);
        curl_setopt_array($ch, [
            CURLOPT_POST => true,
            CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => $protocol,
            CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => [
                'Content-Type: application/octet-stream',
                'X-Cache-Protocol: memcached-text',
                'X-Forwarded-For: ' . ($_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? '127.0.0.1'),
            ],
            CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
            CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 5,
        ]);
        
        $response = curl_exec($ch);
        $httpCode = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
        curl_close($ch);
        
        return $httpCode === 200 && strpos($response, 'STORED') !== false;
    }
}

/**
 * Cache-based session handler using the distributed cache.
 * Sessions are isolated per-user via namespace derived from auth token.
 */
class CacheSessionHandler
{
    private $cache;
    private $sessionPrefix;

    public function __construct(DistributedCacheClient $cache)
    {
        $this->cache = $cache;
        $this->sessionPrefix = 'sess';
    }

    public function read(string $sessionId): string
    {
        // Session IDs are hex strings from the auth layer
        if (!preg_match('/^[a-f0-9]{32,64}$/', $sessionId)) {
            return '';
        }
        
        $result = $this->cache->get($this->sessionPrefix . ':' . $sessionId);
        return is_string($result) ? $result : '';
    }

    public function write(string $sessionId, string $data): bool
    {
        if (!preg_match('/^[a-f0-9]{32,64}$/', $sessionId)) {
            return false;
        }
        
        return $this->cache->set($this->sessionPrefix . ':' . $sessionId, $data, 1800);
    }

    /**
     * Invalidate session. Called on logout.
     */
    public function destroy(string $sessionId): bool
    {
        if (!preg_match('/^[a-f0-9]{32,64}$/', $sessionId)) {
            return false;
        }
        
        return $this->cache->delete($this->sessionPrefix . ':' . $sessionId);
    }
}

// Usage example - API endpoint for cache operations
if (php_sapi_name() !== 'cli') {
    $encoder = new CacheKeyEncoder('app_v2');
    $servers = ['cache-node-1.internal', 'cache-node-2.internal', 'cache-node-3.internal'];
    $client = new DistributedCacheClient($encoder, $servers);
    
    $action = $_GET['action'] ?? 'get';
    $key = $_GET['key'] ?? '';
    
    if (empty($key) || strlen($key) > 128) {
        http_response_code(400);
        exit('Invalid key');
    }
    
    switch ($action) {
        case 'get':
            $result = $client->get($key);
            header('Content-Type: application/json');
            echo json_encode(['value' => $result]);
            break;
        case 'set':
            $value = file_get_contents('php://input');
            $result = $client->set($key, $value);
            echo json_encode(['stored' => $result]);
            break;
        case 'delete':
            $result = $client->delete($key);
            echo json_encode(['deleted' => $result]);
            break;
    }
}
